thread:
nora: Support hit: user resumed a streaming toolcall after truncation and got billed twice. Repro attached.

diego: Symptoms? provisional + confirmed both present in ledger?

nora: Yes. Flow: stream -> provisional row written -> truncation triggered -> client reconnects -> different node writes another confirm. Looks like stitching failed because the node-local pointer was evicted.

anya: We should avoid node-local-only stitching. Quick fix: a tiny global index in redis keyed by (acct, toolcall_id or prefix_hash) with SETNX + TTL. First provisional wins.

ops-bot: note: existing provisional TTL in ledger is 60s.

diego: Can we also propagate a header from router so resume paths carry the provisional id? e.g., `X-Resume-Prov: prov_...`

anya: Yes. Router header + redis SETNX covers both: header helps fast-path; SETNX protects against evictions/canary swaps. Pseudo: ```
key = f"prov:{acct}:{tool_or_hash}"
if redis.setnx(key, prov_id):
  redis.expire(key, 120)
  write_provisional(prov_id)
else:
  canonical = redis.get(key)
  link_to(canonical)  # do not emit new provisional row
```

nora: Console change request: add a toggle to include provisional rows and surface "prov vs conf delta" per customer for quick triage. Also an internal trace endpoint `/internal/billing/trace?prov=...` returning counts and linked ids (no prompt text).

billing-bot: alert: billing aggregation will need to dedupe by canonical_prov_id; creating ticket BT-501. Ensure dedupe uses earliest confirmed or canonical.

diego: Edge case: if canonical never confirms (node crash) TTL expiry could allow duplicates later. We'll pick TTL > expected resume window (eg 120s) and add a reconciliation job to collapse orphans.

anya: Also require `toolcall_id` if present as the primary key; fallback to prefix hash when missing.

nora: Minimal logs to include for triage: session hashes, prov ids, token counts. No PII. Example: ```
INFO nodeA: write provisional prov_a1 acct=acct42 hash=h123 tokens=12
WARN router: truncation at tool boundary sess=sessX
INFO nodeB: resume no-prov -> write provisional prov_b2 acct=acct42 hash=h123 tokens=25
INFO ledger: confirm conf_c1 prov=prov_a1 tokens=12
INFO ledger: confirm conf_c2 prov=prov_b2 tokens=25
```

diego: Action items: anya -> prototype redis SETNX and router header; nora -> console mock + runbook; ops-bot -> add alert for prov/conf delta; billing-bot -> coordinate aggregation patch.

nora: Filing ticket and assigning owners now. Thanks. :thumbsup:
